meta.description: Predictions among friends, points only: scoring rules sealed at kick-off, every point explained line by line, standings that move live, and a league that remembers every season.

landing.decisionsTitle: What we chose, and what it costs

points.refused: Money, stakes, odds or a wallet — anywhere.
points.because: A league is a game of pride; real-money betting is regulated in Québec and Canada.
points.cost: No prize pool. The trophy is on your avatar.

seal.chose: Rules hashed and frozen at kick-off, by the database itself.
seal.refused: An organiser who can edit the scoring after the fact.
seal.because: A rule you can change after the result is not a rule.
seal.cost: A change applies only to matches not yet started — a new version, never a retroactive one.

feed.chose: Match facts through Orazaka's MCP connectors, applied once and in order.
feed.refused: Scores typed in by hand, or a feed trusted blindly.
feed.because: The same goal delivered twice must count once; a late fact must not jump the queue.
feed.cost: We start with one competition and a licensed feed; more come one connector at a time.

how.title: Sealed, live, remembered
how.lead: Three ideas, each held by code you can read.

sealed.title: Sealed at kick-off
sealed.text: The rules are hashed when the first match starts; after that the database refuses any change.

live.title: Live, in real time
live.text: Facts arrive through Orazaka's MCP connector; the standings are recomputed and pushed to every member.

memory.title: A league that remembers
memory.text: Championship stars, trophies, streaks and your nemesis, season after season.

sealed.title: Nobody bends the rules — not even the organiser
sealed.lead: Points for the exact score, the right outcome, the right goal difference, a multiplier for finals: written once, sealed at kick-off.
points: The rule set is stored with its SHA-256 seal; every match keeps the seal it started with.
A change after kick-off is a new version, for matches not yet started — never a rewrite.
Each prediction shows the lines that earned its points.

live.title: The table moves while the match is played
live.lead: Kachizaka reads match facts through Orazaka's MCP connectors and broadcasts the new standings over Server-Sent Events.
points: A fact is stored once and applied in order — a duplicate or a late delivery changes nothing.
Points are provisional while the match runs, final at the whistle.
Predictions lock at kick-off, by the clock and by the facts.

memory.title: Your avatar carries your history
memory.lead: Every season leaves its mark: stars for titles, trophies for the podium, your longest streak, and the friend who always finishes above you.
points: Champion, runner-up and third place, kept season after season.
Your longest run of scoring predictions.
Your nemesis: the member who beat you on the most matchdays.

account.title: Your account, your leagues
account.lead: Kachizaka is in development: accounts are opened by our team for now. Once an account exists, a member can change its password, keep its profile, and recover access by e-mail.
points: Sign in with your e-mail and password; forgot it? A one-use link arrives by e-mail and lasts 30 minutes.
Changing your password ends your other sessions, so a lost phone cannot keep a league open.
Sign-up is closed while Kachizaka is in development: nobody opens an account on their own yet.
Forgot your password? Ask for the link from the sign-in page.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Kachizaka is in development: only the accounts our team creates can sign in. Your account, your leagues and your predictions are kept in Kachizaka's database in Canada, visible to the members of your leagues. Match facts come from a sports data feed through Orazaka, Krizaka's engine; nothing about you is sent there. There is no money, no payment and no advertising. Nothing is sold or shared. To ask a question or have your data removed, use the contact form.
